## EnforceCallOptions.permission property

The capability being invoked, in `app:resource:operation` form (e.g. `'calendar:events:create'`<!-- -->). This string is the single source of truth for `app`<!-- -->, `resource`<!-- -->, and `operation`<!-- -->.
